name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
benefit:
**Stipend:** 12th Pass - 6,000/- ITI / Diploma - 8,000/- Degree / Post Graduation - 10,000/-
**Note:** Stipends are transferred directly to trainees' bank accounts linked with Aadhaar.
_eligibility_text: 1. The candidate should be a resident of Maharashtra. 1. The candidate's age should be between 18 to 35. 1. The candidate should have minimum education criteria of 12th Pass/ITI/Diploma/Graduation/Post Graduation. 1. The candidate should be registered with Aadhaar. 1. The candidate's bank accounts should be linked with Aadhaar.
